title.zh: Polymarket 推出 Protocol V2 重构协议底层架构
title.en: Polymarket Unveils Protocol V2 Rebuilding Its Protocol Architecture

current_state.zh: Polymarket unveiled Protocol V2, a rebuilt prediction-market contract system featuring a single ERC1155 position contract, unified pUSD collateral, a new multi-oracle aggregator, cross-chain bridging as a first-class feature, and audited/verified contracts, with canary markets running October 5–30 and new markets migrating to V2 from November 2.
current_state.en: Polymarket unveiled Protocol V2, a rebuilt prediction-market contract system featuring a single ERC1155 position contract, unified pUSD collateral, a new multi-oracle aggregator, cross-chain bridging as a first-class feature, and audited/verified contracts, with canary markets running October 5–30 and new markets migrating to V2 from November 2.
